prompt: An auditor needs the raw logs of a specific run and wants to fetch them programmatically. Which surface serves them?
explanation: The Actions REST API exposes run logs at the runs endpoint, returning an archive you can script against for audits and retention. REST covers Actions thoroughly — and no repository branch ever stores run logs.

options.text: The Actions REST API, with the run id under `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/logs`
The git protocol, by cloning the `.github/logs` branch
The GraphQL API only — REST has no Actions endpoints
There is no API; logs are downloadable from the browser alone
